metadata.notes: Phase 1 (encryption) and partial Phase 2 (models, service) already implemented

stories.title: Asana OAuth API endpoints
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/v1/integrations/asana/authorize/ returns redirect URL with state
GET /api/v1/integrations/asana/callback/ exchanges code for tokens and saves AsanaIntegration
GET /api/v1/integrations/asana/status/ returns connection status (never tokens)
DELETE /api/v1/integrations/asana/disconnect/ removes integration
errorHandling: Invalid state in callback returns 400 with error message
OAuth failure returns 400 with user-friendly error
testSteps: curl -X GET localhost:8000/api/v1/integrations/asana/status/ -H 'Authorization: Bearer {token}' returns {"connected": false}
Verify AsanaIntegration.access_token is never in any API response
stories.auth: JWT required for all except callback

stories.title: Celery tasks for Asana background sync
acceptanceCriteria: sync_asana_for_user task syncs tasks for a single user
sync_all_asana_users task runs every 5 minutes via Celery beat
Token refresh errors disable sync and log warning
Rate limit errors use exponential backoff
errorHandling: General errors log but don't crash worker
testSteps: docker compose exec web python manage.py shell -c "from core.integrations.asana_tasks import sync_asana_for_user; print('Import OK')"
Verify celery beat schedule includes sync_all_asana_users

stories.title: EchoProfile model and migrations
acceptanceCriteria: EchoProfile model with onboarding_phase (5 phases + complete)
ArrayField for goals, target_platforms, content_pillars
OneToOneField to User
App registered in INSTALLED_APPS
testSteps: docker compose exec -T web python manage.py makemigrations echo --dry-run shows migration
docker compose exec -T web python manage.py migrate runs without error
docker compose exec -T web python manage.py shell -c "from core.echo.models import EchoProfile; print('OK')"

stories.title: EchoConversation and EchoMessage models
acceptanceCriteria: EchoConversation model with session_id, title, timestamps
EchoMessage model with role, content, quick_select JSONField, inline_cards JSONField
ForeignKey from EchoMessage to EchoConversation
Proper ordering (conversations by updated_at desc, messages by created_at asc)
errorHandling: Cascade delete messages when conversation deleted
testSteps: docker compose exec web python manage.py makemigrations echo --dry-run shows migration
docker compose exec web python manage.py migrate runs without error

stories.title: Echo profile API endpoints
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/v1/echo/profile/ returns user's EchoProfile (creates if missing)
PATCH /api/v1/echo/profile/ updates profile fields
Response includes onboarding_phase, goals, target_platforms, content_pillars
testSteps: curl -X GET localhost:8000/api/v1/echo/profile/ -H 'Authorization: Bearer {token}' returns profile
curl -X PATCH with {"onboarding_phase": "platforms"} updates phase
validation: target_platforms must be list of strings

stories.title: EchoWorkspace page with chat layout
acceptanceCriteria: /echo route renders EchoWorkspace page
Chat takes 70% of screen height
Context cards area below chat (collapsed by default)
useEchoProfile hook fetches and caches profile
errorHandling: Auth redirect if not logged in
testSteps: Navigate to /echo shows workspace
Chat input is visible and focusable
Network tab shows GET /api/v1/echo/profile/
stories.loadingState: Skeleton with chat area and context card placeholders
stories.a11y: role=main on workspace, role=log on chat messages
stories.mobile: Full width, context cards stack below chat

stories.title: OnboardingProgress and QuickSelect components
acceptanceCriteria: OnboardingProgress shows 5 steps with filled/empty dots
Current step highlighted in cyan
QuickSelect renders tappable pill buttons
Multi-select mode shows 'Continue' button when items selected
Progress bar only visible during onboarding (phase !== 'complete')
errorHandling: Invalid phase defaults to first step
testSteps: Progress bar shows at /echo for new user
Clicking QuickSelect option highlights it
Progress bar hidden after onboarding complete
stories.a11y: aria-current on active step, buttons have aria-pressed

stories.title: ContextCard, TaskCard, IdeaCard components
acceptanceCriteria: ContextCard shows collapsed summary (title, count)
ContextCard expands on click to show items
TaskCard shows checkbox, title, due date, overdue indicator
IdeaCard shows title, status badge, platform icon
testSteps: Context cards visible below chat
Clicking Tasks card expands to show task list
Overdue tasks show red indicator
stories.a11y: aria-expanded on collapsible cards, checkbox has label

stories.title: Echo agent tools (manage_task, manage_idea, get_context, sync_asana)
acceptanceCriteria: manage_task tool creates/updates/completes tasks via AsanaService
manage_idea tool saves/updates/archives ContentIdea
get_context tool returns tasks summary, ideas, profile, brand voice
sync_asana tool triggers immediate sync
save_onboarding_response tool updates EchoProfile with goals, platforms, pillars
testSteps: docker compose exec web python -c "from services.agents.echo.tools import manage_task; print('OK')"
Tool returns dict with success and data keys

stories.title: Asana Settings page (connect/disconnect)
acceptanceCriteria: /settings/integrations route shows IntegrationsPage
Asana section shows 'Connect' button when not connected
Asana section shows workspace name and 'Disconnect' when connected
Connect redirects to Asana OAuth flow
Disconnect calls DELETE endpoint and updates UI
testSteps: Navigate to /settings/integrations
'Connect with Asana' button visible for unconnected user
After connecting, workspace name displayed
stories.loadingState: Button shows spinner during OAuth redirect
